subject: Confirming decision owner & procurement path — Redwood trial

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
To: Emma Carter <emma@cobaltdiagnostics.com>, procurement@cobaltdiagnostics.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2028-08-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & next steps from today's demo

Hi Emma — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum:

- Demo highlights: streaming latency < 150ms p50 on 8k tokens for the model config we showed; built-in prefix caching should reduce token spend for your workflow.
- Ask: we need to confirm the economic buyer (budget owner) and the procurement contact to accelerate a trial SOW. You mentioned there’s a finance reviewer and a procurement team.
- Security questions: you flagged audit logs and SSO requirements. I attached a short data handling summary (Redwood-Data-Handling-SA.pdf) and a draft trial SOW (trial-sow.docx) for procurement to review.

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm who on your side owns the budget for this pilot (name + email)?
2) Please share the procurement contact and any standard checklist we should follow.
3) If helpful we can schedule a 30-min budget/finance review next week with Samir (if he’s the right person).

If you prefer, I’ll prepare a 1-page summary for your finance team that highlights expected token economics during a 30-day pilot.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood-Data-Handling-SA.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); trial-sow.docx (DOCX, draft)

Hi Rachel — great demo, thanks. Short answers: we believe the economic buyer will be Samir Patel, VP of Finance (samir.patel@cobaltdiagnostics.com). Procurement is handled by Kendall Morris (kendall@cobaltdiagnostics.com) — I’m cc’ing Kendall on this thread so they have the SOW/datasheet.

Couple of procurement/security items Kendall will likely ask for up front:
- SOC 2 Type II report or attestation
- Data retention and deletion policy (how long cached prefixes are stored)
- Encryption in transit + at rest and key management summary

Targeting an internal approval window in Q4; a short pilot + SSO + audit logs answers will speed it. Please share the 1-page economics you mentioned and we’ll route to Samir.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Carter
Head of Product Operations | Cobalt Diagnostics
emma@cobaltdiagnostics.com

  * SOC 2 Type II attestation or SSAE summary (summary acceptable initially)
  * Data handling summary (Redwood-Data-Handling-SA.pdf)
- Our standard procurement checklist attached (Cobalt-procurement-checklist.xlsx). Please fill the red fields (pricing, term, contact for billing) and return.
- We use DocuSign for pilot agreements; see link: https://www.docusign.com/link/placeholder/DEAL-7834.
- Procurement caveats: we need a 30-day data deletion guarantee for cached prefixes used in pilot (or an opt-out). Also need a point of contact for audit requests.

If you can get the packet to me by end of next week we can route to finance (Samir) for review the following week. Preferred next step: Rachel, send Samir the 1-pager and proposed slots — I’ll join the budget review if needed.
